definition_used: One or more authors objected to the notice or the wording of the notice.
caution: This reason indicates author disagreement with a notice, which is a post-publication transparency signal, not a direct indicator of manuscript content or process flaws. It does not confirm any underlying problem with the research, authorship, or editorial processes.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes author objections to a notice or its wording, which directly relates to post-publication transparency and due process oversight. It does not inherently imply issues with research content, attribution, or editorial governance, so only the post-publication category is assigned.
